figures.caption: Fig. 2: The proposed model architecture consists of three main components: a dual-stream backbone network, ECFM modules, and an energy-aware decoder. The backbone network comprises two branches: the event-based ResNet at the bottom and the frame-based ResNet [30] at the top. Each ECFM module operates to enhance features across different hierarchical scales. Subsequently, the energy-aware decoder is used to perform steering angle predictions.
